question: Does the spike precursor have an edge on low-priced names, where the 2026-09-26 mega-cap run said the regime was wrong?

data.feed: sip (consolidated) via Alpaca free tier, query ends >=15 min ago
data.why_not_iex: IEX carries ~3.2% of consolidated volume and emits no bar for a minute with no IEX print (SRFM: 98 of 390 minutes on IEX vs 389 on SIP); the precursor counts in bars

universe.method: every listed NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX common stock, priced at the cutoff close BEFORE the window, filtered, then a fixed-seed random draw — not selected on having moved

gross_edge.method: 0.1% RT run with its cost added back; bootstrap resamples ticker-day clusters, 10k draws, seed 7

verdict: No edge. Gross expectancy is indistinguishable from zero and more likely negative; even the top of its 95% CI (+0.175R) nets -3.30R per trade at this cohort's measured friction (1.6155% round trip = 3.48R at the median stop).
